summary: This diagram illustrates the architecture of a Transformer model, showcasing the flow of data through various components. It features two main sections: the encoder and decoder, each containing multiple layers (denoted as N×). The encoder processes inputs through stages labeled 'Add & Norm', 'Feed Forward', and 'Multi-Head Attention', while the decoder includes similar stages with an additional 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' to prevent information leakage. The inputs are first embedded and then enhanced with positional encoding, while the outputs are generated through a linear transformation followed by a softmax function to produce output probabilities. The diagram emphasizes the iterative nature of the model, with arrows indicating the flow of data and connections between components.
